Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to\n18\t///      the remaining shareholders rather than being swept to the owner.\n19\tcontract UsdtYieldVault is Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n20\t    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n21\t    using Math for uint256;\n22\t\n23\t    /// @notice Denominator for all basis-point maths.\n24\t    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;\n25\t\n26\t    /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n27\t    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n28\t\n29\t    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units (1 USDT).\n30\t    uint256 public constant MIN_DEPOSIT = 1e6;\n31\t\n32\t    /// @notice Fee charged on withdrawal, in basis points.\n33\t    uint256 public constant WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS = 30;\n34\t\n35\t    uint16 private constant AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE = 0;\n36\t\n37\t    /// @notice The underlying asset (USDT).\n38\t    IERC20 public immutable usdt;\n39\t\n40\t    /// @notice The interest-bearing Aave receipt token for `usdt`.\n41\t    IERC20 public immutable aUsdt;\n42\t\n43\t    /// @notice The Aave V3 lending pool deposits are routed through.\n44\t    IAavePool public immutable aavePool;\n45\t\n46\t    /// @notice Fee charged on deposit, in basis points.\n47\t    uint256 public depositFeeBps;\n48\t\n49\t    /// @notice Total shares outstanding across all depositors.\n50\t    uint256 public totalShares;\n51\t\n52\t    /// @notice Vault-tracked USDT supplied to Aave, in USDT base units.\n53\t    uint256 public totalAssetsStored;\n54\t\n55\t    /// @notice Shares held per Withdrawn(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n60\t    event DepositFeeUpdated(uint256 previousFeeBps, uint256 newFeeBps);\n61\t\n62\t    error AmountBelowMinimum();\n63\t    error NoSharesMinted();\n64\t    error ZeroShares();\n65\t    error InsufficientShares();\n66\t\n67\t    /// @param _usdt The underlying USDT token.\n68\t    /// @param granted ownership.\n72\t    constructor(address _usdt, address _aUsdt, address _aavePool, uint256 _depositFeeBps, address initialOwner)\n73\t        Ownable(initialOwner)\n74\t    {\n75\t        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);\n76\t        aUsdt = IERC20(_aUsdt);\n77\t        aavePool = IAavePool(_aavePool);\n78\t        depositFeeBps = _depositFeeBps;\n79\t    }\n80\t\n81\t    /// @notice Supplies `amount` of USDT into the vault and mints shares to the caller.\n82\t    /// @param amount Amount of USDT to deposit, in base units.\n83\t    /// @return shares Number of shares minted to the caller.\n84\t    function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n85\t        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n86\t\n87\t        uint256 fee = (amount * depositFeeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n88\t        uint256 netAmount = amount - fee;\n89\t\n90\t        shares = convertToShares(netAmount);\n91\t        if (shares == 0) revert NoSharesMinted();\n92\t\n93\t        usdt.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n94\t        usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount);\n95\t        aavePool.supply(address(usdt), amount, address(this), AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE);\n96\t\n97\t        totalAssetsStored += amount;\n98\t        totalShares += shares;\n99\t        shareBalance[msg.sender] += shares;\n100\t\n101\t        emit Deposited(msg.sender, amount, shares, fee);\n102\t    }\n103\t\n104\t    /// @notice Burns `shares` and returns the underlying USDT, net of the withdrawal fee.\n105\t    /// @param shares Number of shares to burn.\n106\t    /// @return netAssets USDT sent to the caller, in base units.\n107\t    function withdraw(uint256 shares) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n108\t        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n109\t        if (shareBalance[msg.sender] < shares) revert InsufficientShares();\n110\t\n111\t        uint256 grossAssets = convertToAssets(shares);\n112\t        uint256 fee = (grossAssets * WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n113\t        netAssets = grossAssets - fee;\n114\t\n115\t        shareBalance[msg.sender] -=  }\n136\t\n137\t    /// @notice Resumes deposits and withdrawals.\n138\t    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n139\t        _unpause();\n140\t    }\n141\t\n142\t    /// @notice USDT currently assets) public view returns (uint256) {\n151\t        if (totalShares == 0) {\n152\t            return assets * SHARE_SCALE;\n153\t        }\n154\t        return assets.mulDiv(totalShares, units corresponding to `shares`.\n160\t    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view returns (uint256) {\n161\t        if (totalShares == 0) {\n162\t            return shares / SHARE_SCALE;\n163\t        }\n164\t        return shares.mulDiv(totalAssetsStored, totalShares);\n165\t    }\n166\t\n167\t    /// @notice USDT value currently redeemable by `account`, before the \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\nimport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"./interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @title UsdtYieldVault\n/// @notice Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3 and tracks\n///         depositor ownership with internal shares.\n/// @dev Shares carry 18 decimals while USDT carries 6, so the first depositor\n///      mints at `SHARE_SCALE`. Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to\n///      the remaining shareholders rather than being swept to the owner.\ncontract UsdtYieldVault is Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Denominator for all basis-point maths.\n    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;\n\n    /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n\n    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units (1 USDT).\n    uint256 public constant MIN_DEPOSIT = 1e6;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on withdrawal, in basis points.\n    uint256 public constant WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS = 30;\n\n    uint16 private constant AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE = 0;\n\n    /// @notice The underlying asset (USDT).\n    IERC20 public immutable usdt;\n\n    /// @notice The interest-bearing Aave receipt token for `usdt`.\n    IERC20 public immutable aUsdt;\n\n    /// @notice The Aave V3 lending pool deposits are routed through.\n    IAavePool public immutable aavePool;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on deposit, in basis points.\n    uint256 public depositFeeBps;\n\n    /// @notice Total shares outstanding across all depositors.\n    uint256 public totalShares;\n\n    /// @notice Vault-tracked USDT supplied to Aave, in USDT base units.\n    uint256 public totalAssetsStored;\n\n    /// @notice Shares held per depositor.\n    mapping(address account => uint256 shares) public shareBalance;\n\n    event Deposited(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event DepositFeeUpdated(uint256 previousFeeBps, uint256 newFeeBps);\n\n    error AmountBelowMinimum();\n    error NoSharesMinted();\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error InsufficientShares();\n\n    /// @param _usdt The underlying USDT token.\n    /// @param _aUsdt The Aave aUSDT receipt token.\n    /// @param _aavePool The Aave V3 pool.\n    /// @param _depositFeeBps Initial deposit fee in basis points.\n    /// @param initialOwner Address granted ownership.\n    constructor(address _usdt, address _aUsdt, address _aavePool, uint256 _depositFeeBps, address initialOwner)\n        Ownable(initialOwner)\n    {\n        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);\n        aUsdt = IERC20(_aUsdt);\n        aavePool = IAavePool(_aavePool);\n        depositFeeBps = _depositFeeBps;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Supplies `amount` of USDT into the vault and mints shares to the caller.\n    /// @param amount Amount of USDT to deposit, in base units.\n    /// @return shares Number of shares minted to the caller.\n    function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n\n        uint256 fee = (amount * depositFeeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        uint256 netAmount = amount - fee;\n\n        shares = convertToShares(netAmount);\n        if (shares == 0) revert NoSharesMinted();\n\n        usdt.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount);\n        aavePool.supply(address(usdt), amount, address(this), AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE);\n\n        totalAssetsStored += amount;\n        totalShares += shares;\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] += shares;\n\n        emit Deposited(msg.sender, amount, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Burns `shares` and returns the underlying USDT, net of the withdrawal fee.\n    /// @param shares Number of shares to burn.\n    /// @return netAssets USDT sent to the caller, in base units.\n    function withdraw(uint256 shares) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        if (shareBalance[msg.sender] < shares) revert InsufficientShares();\n\n        uint256 grossAssets = convertToAssets(shares);\n        uint256 fee = (grossAssets * WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        netAssets = grossAssets - fee;\n\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] -= shares;\n        totalShares -= shares;\n        totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets;\n\n        aavePool.withdraw(address(usdt), netAssets, msg.sender);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, netAssets, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Updates the deposit fee.\n    /// @param newFeeBps New deposit fee in basis points.\n    function setDepositFee(uint256 newFeeBps) external onlyOwner {\n        uint256 previousFeeBps = depositFeeBps;\n        depositFeeBps = newFeeBps;\n        emit DepositFeeUpdated(previousFeeBps, newFeeBps);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pauses deposits and withdrawals.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Resumes deposits and withdrawals.\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT currently tracked by the vault, in base units.\n    function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return totalAssetsStored;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts a USDT amount into shares at the current share price.\n    /// @param assets USDT amount in base units.\n    /// @return Shares corresponding to `assets`.\n    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return assets * SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return assets.mulDiv(totalShares, totalAssetsStored);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts shares into a USDT amount at the current share price.\n    /// @param shares Share amount.\n    /// @return USDT in base units corresponding to `shares`.\n    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return shares / SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return shares.mulDiv(totalAssetsStored, totalShares);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT value currently redeemable by `account`, before the withdrawal fee.\n    function balanceOfUnderlying(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return convertToAssets(shareBalance[account]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Current share price, expressed as USDT base units per 1e18 shares.\n    function sharePrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n {\n18\t        return 6;\n19\t    }\n20\t\n21\t    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n22\t        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n23\t        _mint(to, amount);\n24\t    }\n25\t\n26\t    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n27\t        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n28\t        _burn(from, amount);\n29\t    }\n30\t}\n31\t\n32\t/// \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Receipt token minted by {MockAavePool}, mirroring aUSDT.\ncontract MockAToken is ERC20 {\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    constructor(address _pool) ERC20(\"Aave Tether USD\", \"aUSDT\") {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _burn(from, amount);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Stand-in for the Aave V3 pool used across the test suite.\ncontract MockAavePool is IAavePool {\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    MockAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new MockAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns 0.8.28;\n3\t\n4\timport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n5\timport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n6\timport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n7\t\n8\timport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\n9\timport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\n10\timport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n11\t\n12\tcontract UsdtYieldVaultTest is Test {\n13\t    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n14\t    MockUSDT public usdt;\n15\t    MockAavePool public pool;\n16\t    MockAToken public aUsdt;\n17\t\n18\t    address public owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n19\t    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n20\t    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n21\t\n22\t    uint256 public constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n23\t    uint256 public constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n24\t\n25\t    function setUp() public {\n26\t        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n27\t        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n28\t        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n29\t        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n30\t\n31\t        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n32\t        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n33\t\n34\t        vm.prank(alice);\n35\t        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n36\t        vm.prank(bob);\n37\t        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n38\t    }\n39\t\n40\t    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n41\t        vm.prank(account);\n42\t        return vault.deposit(amount);\n43\t    }\n44\t\n45\t    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n46\t                              CONSTRUCTOR\n47\t    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n48\t\n49\t    function test_ConstructorSetsUsdt() public view {\n50\t        assertEq(address(vault.usdt()), address(usdt));\n51\t    }\n52\t\n53\t    function test_ConstructorSetsAUsdt() public view {\n54\t        assertEq(address(vault.aUsdt()), address(aUsdt));\n55\t    }\n56\t\n57\t    function test_ConstructorSetsAavePool() public view {\n58\t        assertEq(address(vault.aavePool()), address(pool));\n59\t    }\n60\t\n61\t    function test_ConstructorSetsOwner() public view {\n62\t        assertEq(vault.owner(), owner);\n63\t    }\n64\t\n65\t    function test_ConstructorSetsDepositFee() public view {\n66\t        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), INITIAL_FEE_BPS);\n67\t    }\n68\t\n69\t    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n70\t                               CONSTANTS\n71\t    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n72\t\n73\t    function test_BpsDenominator() public view {\n74\t        assertEq(vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 10_000);\n75\t    }\n76\t\n77\t    function test_ShareScale() public view {\n78\t        assertEq(vault.SHARE_SCALE(), 1e12);\n79\t    }\n80\t\n81\t    function test_MinDeposit() public view {\n82\t        assertEq(vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 1e6);\n83\t    }\n84\t\n85\t    function test_WithdrawFeeBps() public view {\n86\t        assertEq(vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS(), 30);\n87\t    }\n88\t\n89\t    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n90\t                                DEPOSIT\n91\t    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n92\t\n93\t    function test_DepositMintsShares() public {\n94\t        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n95\t        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n96\t        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 999e18);\n97\t    }\n98\t\n99\t    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalShares() public {\n100\t        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n101\t        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 999e18);\n102\t    }\n103\t\n104\t    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalAssets() public {\n105\t        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n106\t        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n107\t        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n108\t    }\n109\t\n110\t    function test_DepositTransfersUsdtFromDepositor() public {\n111\t        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n112\t        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n113\t        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n114\t    }\n115\t\n116\t    function test_DepositSuppliesToAave() public {\n117\t        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n118\t        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n119\t    }\n120\t\n121\t    function test_DepositEmitsEvent() public {\n122\t        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n123\t        emit UsdtYieldVault.Deposited(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, 999e18, 1e6);\n124\t        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n125\t    }\n126\t\n127\t    function test_SecondDepositorMintsShares() public {\n128\t        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n129\t        uint256 shares = _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n130\t        assertGt(shares, 0);\n131\t        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), shares);\n132\t    }\n133\t\n134\t    function test_RevertWhen_DepositBelowMinimum() public {\n135\t        vm.prank(alice);\n136\t        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.AmountBelowMinimum.selector);\n137\t        vault.deposit(1e6 - 1);\n138\t    }\n139\t\n140\t    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n141\t                                WITHDRAW\n142\t    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n143\t\n144\t    function test_WithdrawReturnsUsdt() public {\n145\t        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n146\t        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n147\t\n148\t        vm.prank(alice);\n149\t        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(shares);\n150\t\n151\t        assertEq(netAssets, 997e6);\n152\t        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore + 997e6);\n153\t    }\n154\t\n155\t    function test_WithdrawBurnsShares() public {\n156\t        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n157\t\n158\t        vm.prank(alice);\n159\t        vault.withdraw(shares);\n160\t\n161\t        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n162\t        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n163\t    }\n164\t\n165\t    function test_WithdrawEmitsEvent() public {\n166\t        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n167\t\n168\t        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n169\t        emit SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\ncontract UsdtYieldVaultTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    MockAavePool public pool;\n    MockAToken public aUsdt;\n\n    address public owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 public constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 public constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.usdt()), address(usdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aUsdt()), address(aUsdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAavePool() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aavePool()), address(pool));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsOwner() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), owner);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsDepositFee() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), INITIAL_FEE_BPS);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                               CONSTANTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_BpsDenominator() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 10_000);\n    }\n\n    function test_ShareScale() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.SHARE_SCALE(), 1e12);\n    }\n\n    function test_MinDeposit() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeBps() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS(), 30);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                DEPOSIT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_DepositMintsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositTransfersUsdtFromDepositor() public {\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositSuppliesToAave() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Deposited(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, 999e18, 1e6);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_SecondDepositorMintsShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_DepositBelowMinimum() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.AmountBelowMinimum.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1e6 - 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                WITHDRAW\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawReturnsUsdt() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 997e6);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore + 997e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawBurnsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawEmitsEvent() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Withdrawn(alice, 997e6, shares, 3e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_PartialWithdraw() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares / 2);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), shares / 2);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawZeroShares() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.ZeroShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(0);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawExceedsBalance() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.InsufficientShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares + 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  FEES\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeUpdatesValue() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(false, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.DepositFeeUpdated(INITIAL_FEE_BPS, 25);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeToZero() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerSetsDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                 PAUSING\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_PauseBlocksDeposit() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_UnpauseRestoresDeposit() public {\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.unpause();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerPauses() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.pause();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  VIEWS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_TotalAssetsStartsAtZero() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceStartsAtOneUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.sharePrice(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 1e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlying() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlyingIsZeroForNonDepositor() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), 0);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":300,"startLine":1,"totalLines":300}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/.claude/skills/testing\n\n# Smart Contract Testing\n\n## What You Probably Got Wrong\n\n**You test getters and trivial functions.** Testing that `name()` returns the name is worthless. Test edge cases, failure modes, and economic invariants — the things that lose money when they break.\n\n**You don't fuzz.** `forge test` finds the bugs you thought of. Fuzzing finds the ones you didn't. If your contract does math, fuzz it. If it handles user input, fuzz it. If it moves value, definitely fuzz it.\n\n**You don't fork-test.** If your contract calls Uniswap, Aave, or any external protocol (verified addresses: `addresses/SKILL.md`), test against their real deployed contracts on a fork. Mocking them hides integration bugs that only appear with real state.\n\n**You write tests that mirror the implementation.** Testing that `deposit(100)` sets `balance[user] = 100` is tautological — you're testing that Solidity assignments work. Test properties: \"after deposit and withdraw, user gets their tokens back.\" Test invariants: \"total deposits always equals contract balance.\"\n\n**You skip invariant testing for stateful protocols.** If your contract has multiple interacting functions that change state over time (vaults, AMMs, lending), you need invariant tests. Unit tests check one path; invariant tests check that properties hold across thousands of random sequences.\n\n---\n\n## Unit Testing with Foundry\n\n### Test File Structure\n\n```solidity\n// test/MyContract.t.sol\n// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {Test, console} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {MyToken} from \"../src/MyToken.sol\";\n\ncontract MyTokenTest is Test {\n    MyToken public token;\n    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        token = new MyToken(\"Test\", \"TST\", 1_000_000e18);\n        // Give alice some tokens for testing\n        token.transfer(alice, 10_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_TransferUpdatesBalances() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        token.transfer(bob, 1_000e18);\n\n        assertEq(token.balanceOf(alice), 9_000e18);\n        assertEq(token.balanceOf(bob), 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_TransferEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(true, true, false, true);\n        emit Transfer(alice, bob, 500e18);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        token.transfer(bob, 500e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_TransferExceedsBalance() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        token.transfer(bob, 999_999e18); // More than alice has\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_TransferToZeroAddress() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        token.transfer(address(0), 100e18);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### Key Assertion Patterns\n\n```solidity\n// Equality\nassertEq(actual, expected);\nassertEq(actual, expected, \"descriptive error message\");\n\n// Comparisons\nassertGt(a, b);   // a > b\nassertGe(a, b);   // a >= b\nassertLt(a, b);   // a < b\nassertLe(a, b);   // a <= b\n\n// Approximate equality (for math with rounding)\nassertApproxEqAbs(actual, expected, maxDelta);\nassertApproxEqRel(actual, expected, maxPercentDelta); // in WAD (1e18 = 100%)\n\n// Revert expectations\nvm.expectRevert();                           // Any revert\nvm.expectRevert(\"Insufficient balance\");     // Specific message\nvm.expectRevert(MyContract.CustomError.selector); // Custom error\n\n// Event expectations\nvm.expectEmit(true, true, false, true);      // (topic1, topic2, topic3, data)\nemit MyEvent(expectedArg1, expectedArg2);\n```\n\n### What to Actually Test\n\n```solidity\n// ✅ TEST: Edge cases that lose money\nfunction test_TransferZeroAmount() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_TransferEntireBalance() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_TransferToSelf() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_ApproveOverwrite() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_TransferFromWithExactAllowance() public { /* ... */ }\n\n// ✅ TEST: Access control\nfunction test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerCallsAdminFunction() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_OwnerCanPause() public { /* ... */ }\n\n// ✅ TEST: Failure modes\nfunction test_RevertWhen_DepositZero() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_RevertWhen_WithdrawMoreThanDeposited() public { /* ... */ }\nfunction test_RevertWhen_ContractPaused() public { /* ... */ }\n\n// ❌ DON'T TEST: OpenZeppelin internals\n// function test_NameReturnsName() — they already tested this\n// function test_SymbolReturnsSymbol() — waste of time\n// function test_DecimalsReturns18() — it does, trust it\n```\n\n---\n\n## Fuzz Testing\n\nFoundry automatically fuzzes any test function with parameters. Instead of testing one value, it tests hundreds of random values.\n\n### Basic Fuzz Test\n\n```solidity\n// Foundry calls this with random amounts\nfunction testFuzz_DepositWithdrawRoundtrip(uint256 amount) public {\n    // Bound input to valid range\n    amount = bound(amount, 1, token.balanceOf(alice));\n\n    uint256 balanceBefore = token.balanceOf(alice);\n\n    vm.startPrank(alice);\n    token.approve(address(vault), amount);\n    vault.deposit(amount, alice);\n    vault.withdraw(vault.balanceOf(alice), alice, alice);\n    vm.stopPrank();\n\n    // Property: user gets back what they deposited (minus any fees)\n    assertGe(token.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - 1); // Allow 1 wei rounding\n}\n```\n\n### Bounding Inputs\n\n```solidity\n// bound() is preferred over vm.assume() — bound reshapes, assume discards\nfunction testFuzz_Fee(uint256 amount, uint256 feeBps) public {\n    amount = bound(amount, 1e6, 1e30);       // Reasonable token amounts\n    feeBps = bound(feeBps, 1, 10_000);       // 0.01% to 100%\n\n    uint256 fee = (amount * feeBps) / 10_000;\n    uint256 afterFee = amount - fee;\n\n    // Property: fee + remainder always equals original\n    assertEq(fee + afterFee, amount);\n}\n\n// vm.assume() discards inputs — use sparingly\nfunction testFuzz_Division(uint256 a, uint256 b) public {\n    vm.assume(b > 0); // Skip zero (would revert)\n    // ...\n}\n```\n\n### Run with More Iterations\n\n```bash\n# Default: 256 runs\nforge test\n\n# More thorough: 10,000 runs\nforge test --fuzz-runs 10000\n\n# Set in foundry.toml for CI\n# [fuzz]\n# runs = 1000\n```\n\n---\n\n## Fork Testing\n\nTest your contract against real deployed protocols on a mainnet fork. This catches integration bugs that mocks can't.\n\n### Basic Fork Test\n\n```solidity\ncontract SwapTest is Test {\n    // Real mainnet addresses — full verified list: addresses/SKILL.md\n    address constant UNISWAP_ROUTER = 0x68b3465833fb72A70ecDF485E0e4C7bD8665Fc45;\n    address constant WETH = 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2;\n    address constant USDC = 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        // Fork mainnet at a specific block for reproducibility\n        vm.createSelectFork(\"mainnet\", 19_000_000);\n    }\n\n    function test_SwapETHForUSDC() public {\n        address user = makeAddr(\"user\");\n        vm.deal(user, 1 ether);\n\n        vm.startPrank(user);\n\n        // Build swap path\n        ISwapRouter.ExactInputSingleParams memory params = ISwapRouter\n            .ExactInputSingleParams({\n                tokenIn: WETH,\n                tokenOut: USDC,\n                fee: 3000,\n                recipient: user,\n                amountIn: 0.1 ether,\n                amountOutMinimum: 0, // In production, NEVER set to 0\n                sqrtPriceLimitX96: 0\n            });\n\n        // Execute swap\n        uint256 amountOut = ISwapRouter(UNISWAP_ROUTER).exactInputSingle{value: 0.1 ether}(params);\n\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        // Verify we got USDC back\n        assertGt(amountOut, 0, \"Should receive USDC\");\n        assertGt(IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(user), 0);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### When to Fork-Test\n\n- **Always:** Any contract that calls an external protocol (Uniswap, Aave, Chainlink)\n- **Always:** Any contract that handles tokens with quirks (USDT, fee-on-transfer, rebasing)\n- **Always:** Any contract that reads oracle prices\n- **Never:** Pure logic contracts with no external calls — use unit tests\n\n### Running Fork Tests\n\n```bash\n# Fork from RPC URL\nforge test --fork-url https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY\n\n# Fork at specific block (reproducible)\nforge test --fork-url https://eth-mainnet.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY --fork-block-number 19000000\n\n# Set in foundry.toml to avoid CLI flags\n# [rpc_endpoints]\n# mainnet = \"${MAINNET_RPC_URL}\"\n```\n\n---\n\n## Invariant Testing\n\nInvariant tests verify that properties hold across thousands of random function call sequences. Essential for stateful protocols.\n\n### What Are Invariants?\n\nInvariants are properties that must ALWAYS be true, no matter what sequence of actions users take:\n\n- \"Total supply equals sum of all balances\" (ERC-20)\n- \"Total deposits equals total shares times share price\" (vault)\n- \"x * y >= k after every swap\" (AMM)\n- \"User can always withdraw what they deposited\" (escrow)\n\n### Basic Invariant Test\n\n```solidity\ncontract VaultInvariantTest is Test {\n    MyVault public vault;\n    IERC20 public token;\n    VaultHandler public handler;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        token = new MockERC20(\"Test\", \"TST\", 18);\n        vault = new MyVault(token);\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, token);\n\n        // Tell Foundry which contract to call randomly\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    // This runs after every random sequence\n    function invariant_TotalAssetsMatchesBalance() public view {\n        assertEq(\n            vault.totalAssets(),\n            token.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            \"Total assets must equal actual balance\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    function invariant_SharePriceNeverZero() public view {\n        if (vault.totalSupply() > 0) {\n            assertGt(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 0, \"Share price must never be zero\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Handler: guided random actions\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    MyVault public vault;\n    IERC20 public token;\n\n    constructor(MyVault _vault, IERC20 _token) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        token = _token;\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, 1, 1e24);\n        deal(address(token), msg.sender, amount);\n\n        vm.startPrank(msg.sender);\n        token.approve(address(vault), amount);\n        vault.deposit(amount, msg.sender);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 shares) public {\n        uint256 maxShares = vault.balanceOf(msg.sender);\n        if (maxShares == 0) return;\n        shares = bound(shares, 1, maxShares);\n\n        vm.prank(msg.sender);\n        vault.redeem(shares, msg.sender, msg.sender);\n    }\n}\n```\n\n### Running Invariant Tests\n\n```bash\n# Default depth (15 calls per sequence, 256 sequences)\nforge test\n\n# Deeper exploration\nforge test --fuzz-runs 1000\n\n# Configure in foundry.toml\n# [invariant]\n# runs = 512\n# depth = 50\n```\n\n---\n\n## What NOT to Test\n\n- **OpenZeppelin internals.** Don't test that `ERC20.transfer` works. It's been audited by dozens of firms and used by thousands of contracts. Test YOUR logic on top of it.\n- **Solidity language features.** Don't test that `require` reverts or that `mapping` stores values. The compiler works.\n- **Every getter.** If `name()` returns the name you passed to the constructor, that's not a test — it's a tautology.\n- **Happy path only.** The happy path probably works. Test the unhappy paths: what happens with zero? Max uint? Unauthorized callers? Reentrancy?\n\n**Focus your testing effort on:** Custom business logic, mathematical operations, integration points with external protocols, access control boundaries, and economic edge cases.\n\n---\n\n## Pre-Deploy Test Checklist\n\n- [ ] All custom logic has unit tests with edge cases\n- [ ] Zero amounts, max uint, empty arrays, self-transfers tested\n- [ ] Access control verified — unauthorized calls revert\n- [ ] Fuzz tests on all mathematical operations (minimum 1000 runs)\n- [ ] Fork tests for every external protocol integration\n- [ ] Invariant tests for stateful protocols (vaults, AMMs, lending)\n- [ ] Events verified with `expectEmit`\n- [ ] Gas snapshots taken with `forge snapshot` to catch regressions\n- [ ] Static analysis with `slither .` — no high/medium findings unaddressed\n- [ ] All tests pass: `forge test -vvv`\n"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"4c5c5a68-fa20-4398-89af-ecd5cfc2763e","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:39:45.395Z","isSynthetic":true}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGMhGzvFZxz32eEWiCc","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XaNnWBCnAWV92KSiT6TDJH","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/test/harness/UsdtLikeToken.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\n/// @notice Faithful stand-in for the *real* TetherToken ABI at\n///         0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7.\n/// @dev The point of this contract is everything `MockUSDT` gets wrong:\n///\n///      1. `approve`, `transfer` and `transferFrom` declare NO return value.\n///         Real USDT predates EIP-20 finalisation and returns empty calldata.\n///         A caller holding an `IERC20` reference will ABI-decode the empty\n///         returndata and revert.\n///      2. `approve` refuses a non-zero -> non-zero allowance change.\n///      3. A `basisPointsRate` transfer fee exists and is owner-settable\n///         (currently 0 on mainnet, but the switch is live).\n///\n///      Storage/logic mirrors TetherToken; only the parts the vault touches\n///      are implemented.\ncontract UsdtLikeToken {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    uint256 public basisPointsRate;\n    uint256 public maximumFee;\n\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balanceOf[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Owner-settable transfer fee, exactly as TetherToken.setParams.\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external {\n        basisPointsRate = newBasisPoints;\n        maximumFee = newMaxFee * 10 ** uint256(decimals);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no `returns (bool)`. This is the whole point.\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        // TetherToken: require(!((_value != 0) && (allowed[msg.sender][_spender] != 0)));\n        require(!((value != 0) && (allowance[msg.sender][spender] != 0)), \"unsafe-allowance-change\");\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no `returns (bool)`.\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no `returns (bool)`.\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            require(allowed >= value, \"allowance\");\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"balance\");\n\n        uint256 fee = (value * basisPointsRate) / 10_000;\n        if (fee > maximumFee) fee = maximumFee;\n        uint256 sendAmount = value - fee;\n\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += sendAmount;\n        if (fee > 0) {\n            balanceOf[address(this)] += fee;\n            emit Transfer(from, address(this), fee);\n        }\n        emit Transfer(from, to, sendAmount);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":9489,"cache_read_input_tokens":55591,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":9489},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"d084b7aa-dbd1-4109-9e39-8b7ddc6f0f43","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:43:06.389Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGMaF5d1brRL69Y688i"}

This is the whole point.\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external {\n        // TetherToken: require(!((_value != 0) && (allowed[msg.sender][_spender] != 0)));\n        require(!((value != 0) && (allowance[msg.sender][spender] != 0)), \"unsafe-allowance-change\");\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no `returns (bool)`.\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev NOTE: no `returns (bool)`.\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) external {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            require(allowed >= value, \"allowance\");\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"balance\");\n\n        uint256 fee = (value * basisPointsRate) / 10_000;\n        if (fee > maximumFee) fee = maximumFee;\n        uint256 sendAmount = value - fee;\n\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += sendAmount;\n        if (fee > 0) {\n            balanceOf[address(this)] += fee;\n            emit Transfer(from, address(this), fee);\n        }\n        emit Transfer(from, to, sendAmount);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGPPtYbqcECfa7pwg92","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Rir2GzogAQp8icjJzprRiC","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/test/harness/RebasingAavePool.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {SafeERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice aToken whose balance grows with a liquidity index, like real aUSDT.\n/// @dev `test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol` mints a fixed, non-growing receipt token.\n///      Real Aave V3 aTokens are rebasing: `balanceOf` = scaledBalance * index.\n///      Every yield-related behaviour of the vault is invisible to a mock that\n///      cannot accrue.\ncontract RebasingAToken {\n    string public constant name = \"Aave Ethereum USDT\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"aEthUSDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    /// @notice Index in ray, monotonically increasing as interest accrues.\n    uint256 public liquidityIndex = RAY;\n\n    mapping(address => uint256) public scaledBalanceOf;\n    uint256 public scaledTotalSupply;\n\n    constructor(address _pool) {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyPool() {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledBalanceOf[account] * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledTotalSupply * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY) / liquidityIndex;\n        scaledBalanceOf[to] += scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply += scaled;\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        // Round the scaled burn up so the holder can never burn more value\n        // than they own, matching Aave's rayDiv rounding direction.\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY + liquidityIndex - 1) / liquidityIndex;\n        require(scaledBalanceOf[from] >= scaled, \"burn exceeds balance\");\n        scaledBalanceOf[from] -= scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply -= scaled;\n    }\n\n    function accrue(uint256 bps) external {\n        liquidityIndex = (liquidityIndex * (10_000 + bps)) / 10_000;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Aave V3 pool stand-in that pays interest and tolerates\n///         non-standard ERC-20s (uses SafeERC20 on the underlying).\ncontract RebasingAavePool is IAavePool {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    RebasingAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new RebasingAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        aToken.burn(msg.sender, amount);\n        underlying.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Grow every depositor's aToken balance by `bps`.\n    /// @dev The pool must be funded with the extra underlying for the yield to\n    ///      be withdrawable; the test does that via the token's `mint`.\n    function accrueInterest(uint256 bps) external {\n        aToken.accrue(bps);\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1650,"cache_read_input_tokens":65080,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1650},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"92dedcfd-083b-4cca-8aaf-c4b6ecc173d5","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:43:26.519Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGPNPzxGmmdsuoedGKP"}

constructor(address _pool) {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    modifier onlyPool() {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledBalanceOf[account] * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledTotalSupply * liquidityIndex) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY) / liquidityIndex;\n        scaledBalanceOf[to] += scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply += scaled;\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external onlyPool {\n        // Round the scaled burn up so the holder can never burn more value\n        // than they own, matching Aave's rayDiv rounding direction.\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY + liquidityIndex - 1) / liquidityIndex;\n        require(scaledBalanceOf[from] >= scaled, \"burn exceeds balance\");\n        scaledBalanceOf[from] -= scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply -= scaled;\n    }\n\n    function accrue(uint256 bps) external {\n        liquidityIndex = (liquidityIndex * (10_000 + bps)) / 10_000;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Aave V3 pool stand-in that pays interest and tolerates\n///         non-standard ERC-20s (uses SafeERC20 on the underlying).\ncontract RebasingAavePool is IAavePool {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    RebasingAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new RebasingAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        aToken.burn(msg.sender, amount);\n        underlying.safeTransfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Grow every depositor's aToken balance by `bps`.\n    /// @dev The pool must be funded with the extra underlying for the yield to\n    ///      be withdrawable; the test does that via the token's `mint`.\n    function accrueInterest(uint256 bps) external {\n        aToken.accrue(bps);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGQsP3xUFAkK6QKjzb7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1872,"cache_read_input_tokens":66730,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1872},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"b92da1d2-f7e4-493f-9ae6-de7376f4d7e5","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:44:21.480Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGQrCcTJQveoVcqua5V"}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGQsP3xUFAkK6QKjzb7","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01REkypwvfiPFy9fSX5gnPu4","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/test/VaultRealWorld.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {UsdtLikeToken} from \"./harness/UsdtLikeToken.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/RebasingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Property tests for UsdtYieldVault against a realistic environment:\n///         a token with the real USDT ABI, and an Aave pool whose aToken\n///         actually accrues interest.\n///\n///         Every test here asserts the behaviour the README and the NatSpec\n///         promise. They are expected to FAIL against src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\n///         as it stands. Each failure is a finding.\ncontract VaultRealWorldTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant FEE_BPS = 10; // same as the shipped test suite\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Grow every aToken holder's balance by `bps` and fund the pool with\n    ///      the underlying needed to make that yield withdrawable.\n    function _accrue(uint256 bps) internal {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(address(pool));\n        pool.accrueInterest(bps);\n        usdt.mint(address(pool), (before * bps) / 10_000);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  The real USDT ABI\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault must be able to take a deposit of the token it is\n    ///         being deployed against: real USDT, whose approve() returns void.\n    function test_DepositWorksAgainstRealUsdtAbi() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n        RebasingAavePool realPool = new RebasingAavePool(address(realUsdt));\n        UsdtYieldVault v =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(realUsdt), address(realPool.aToken()), address(realPool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        realUsdt.mint(alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        realUsdt.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try v.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256 shares) {\n            assertGt(shares, 0);\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted. returndata length:\", err.length);\n            console2.log(\"USDT.approve() returns void; the vault decodes it as bool -> revert\");\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-1: deposit() reverts against a real-USDT-ABI token\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pins the root cause: a raw IERC20.approve on a USDT-ABI token\n    ///         reverts, while SafeERC20/forceApprove would not.\n    function test_RawApproveOnUsdtAbiReverts() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n\n        // Low-level: the token itself is happy, it just answers with 0 bytes.\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(realUsdt).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(this), 1));\n        assertTrue(ok, \"low-level approve should succeed\");\n        console2.log(\"USDT-ABI approve() returndata length:\", ret.length);\n\n        // Typed: identical call through IERC20 cannot decode 0 bytes as bool.\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"F-1: USDT.approve() returns no data; IERC20.approve() will revert on decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Aave yield never reaches depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice It is a yield vault. Interest earned in Aave must be redeemable\n    ///         by the depositor who earned it.\n    function test_AaveYieldReachesDepositors() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _accrue(500); // +5% supplied in Aave\n\n        uint256 aTokenHeld = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aTokenHeld);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console2.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying    :\", credited);\n        console2.log(\"yield lost to alice          :\", aTokenHeld - credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, aTokenHeld, \"F-2: 5% Aave interest is not credited to the depositor\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice totalAssets() is the vault's price feed. It must reflect what\n    ///         the vault owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAavePosition() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice before accrual:\", priceBefore);\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice after  accrual:\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"F-2: totalAssets() ignores Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Fees are stranded, not distributed\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders.\" Check the withdrawal fee does that.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(aliceShares);\n        uint256 withdrawFee = (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"withdraw fee alice paid :\", withdrawFee);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying before   :\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying after    :\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"bob actually gained     :\", bobAfter - bobBefore);\n\n        assertEq(bobAfter - bobBefore, withdrawFee, \"F-3: withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Vault accounting must match the position it actually holds.\n    function test_AccountingMatchesAavePositionAfterWithdraw() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 tracked = vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held      :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored:\", tracked);\n        console2.log(\"untracked (lost) :\", held - tracked);\n\n        assertEq(held, tracked, \"F-3: withdrawal fee leaves the accounting, not the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice After the last shareholder exits, nothing of value may remain\n    ///         trapped: the vault has no sweep, rescue or aToken transfer path.\n    function test_NothingIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"all shares burned\");\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        console2.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded forever :\", stranded);\n\n        assertEq(stranded, 0, \"F-3: aUSDT is permanently unrecoverable - no function can move it\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The deposit fee is not charged to the depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who pays a fee must actually be poorer by that fee.\n    function test_DepositFeeIsActuallyCharged() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 expectedFee = (DEPOSIT * FEE_BPS) / 10_000;\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"deposited        :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"fee charged      :\", expectedFee);\n        console2.log(\"credited to alice:\", credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, DEPOSIT - expectedFee, \"F-4: sole depositor is refunded 100% of their own deposit fee\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Unbounded owner-controlled deposit fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A deposit fee above 100% is nonsense and must be rejected.\n    function test_SetDepositFeeRejectsAbove100Percent() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The owner must not be able to confiscate a user's deposit by\n    ///         moving the fee between the user's approval and their deposit.\n    function test_OwnerCannotConfiscateDepositsViaFee() public {\n        // Owner takes a position first.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        _deposit(owner, DEPOSIT);\n\n        // Owner front-runs alice's pending deposit with a fee hike.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        uint256 victimDeposit = 10_000e6;\n        uint256 ownerBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner);\n        _deposit(alice, victimDeposit);\n\n        uint256 aliceCredited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 ownerGained = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner) - ownerBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited        :\", victimDeposit);\n        console2.log(\"alice can redeem       :\", aliceCredited);\n        console2.log(\"owner gained           :\", ownerGained);\n\n        assertGe(aliceCredited, (victimDeposit * 99) / 100, \"F-5: owner can redirect ~100% of a deposit to themselves\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A fee above BPS_DENOMINATOR must not brick deposits outright.\n    function test_DepositStillWorksAtMaxFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted after setDepositFee(10001), returndata:\");\n            console2.logBytes(err);\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-5: fee > 100% underflows amount - fee and bricks every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Pause traps user funds\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Users must always be able to exit. Pausing deposits is fine;\n    ///         pausing withdrawals locks depositors in.\n    function test_UsersCanExitWhilePaused() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: paused vault blocks withdraw() - depositors cannot exit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Funds must not become permanently unreachable through an\n    ///         ordinary, un-guarded owner action.\n    function test_FundsSurviveOwnershipRenouncement() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership(); // inherited from Ownable, not overridden\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0));\n        assertTrue(vault.paused(), \"vault is paused with no owner left to unpause\");\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: pause + renounceOwnership permanently freezes every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        FUZZ\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Across any deposit size and any Aave accrual, the depositor's\n    ///         redeemable balance must track the vault's aToken position.\n    function testFuzz_DepositorTracksAavePosition(uint256 amount, uint256 accrualBps) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        accrualBps = bound(accrualBps, 1, 2_000);\n\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _accrue(accrualBps);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            1,\n            \"F-2: depositor balance does not follow the Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sanity check in the other direction: share conversion must never\n    ///         mint value out of nothing. This one is expected to hold.\n    function testFuzz_ConversionCreatesNoValue(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _deposit(bob, amount);\n\n        uint256 probe = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        assertLe(vault.convertToAssets(vault.convertToShares(probe)), probe, \"conversion round-trip creates value\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1872,"cache_read_input_tokens":66730,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1872},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"5f68e313-97fa-40f9-ab90-fb01a71e531a","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:45:18.607Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGQrCcTJQveoVcqua5V"}
