They are expected to FAIL against src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\n///         as it stands. Each failure is a finding.\ncontract VaultRealWorldTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant FEE_BPS = 10; // same as the shipped test suite\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Grow every aToken holder's balance by `bps` and fund the pool with\n    ///      the underlying needed to make that yield withdrawable.\n    function _accrue(uint256 bps) internal {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(address(pool));\n        pool.accrueInterest(bps);\n        usdt.mint(address(pool), (before * bps) / 10_000);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  The real USDT ABI\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault must be able to take a deposit of the token it is\n    ///         being deployed against: real USDT, whose approve() returns void.\n    function test_DepositWorksAgainstRealUsdtAbi() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n        RebasingAavePool realPool = new RebasingAavePool(address(realUsdt));\n        UsdtYieldVault v =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(realUsdt), address(realPool.aToken()), address(realPool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        realUsdt.mint(alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        realUsdt.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try v.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256 shares) {\n            assertGt(shares, 0);\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted. returndata length:\", err.length);\n            console2.log(\"USDT.approve() returns void; the vault decodes it as bool -> revert\");\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-1: deposit() reverts against a real-USDT-ABI token\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pins the root cause: a raw IERC20.approve on a USDT-ABI token\n    ///         reverts, while SafeERC20/forceApprove would not.\n    function test_RawApproveOnUsdtAbiReverts() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n\n        // Low-level: the token itself is happy, it just answers with 0 bytes.\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(realUsdt).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(this), 1));\n        assertTrue(ok, \"low-level approve should succeed\");\n        console2.log(\"USDT-ABI approve() returndata length:\", ret.length);\n\n        // Typed: identical call through IERC20 cannot decode 0 bytes as bool.\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"F-1: USDT.approve() returns no data; IERC20.approve() will revert on decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Aave yield never reaches depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice It is a yield vault. Interest earned in Aave must be redeemable\n    ///         by the depositor who earned it.\n    function test_AaveYieldReachesDepositors() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _accrue(500); // +5% supplied in Aave\n\n        uint256 aTokenHeld = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aTokenHeld);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console2.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying    :\", credited);\n        console2.log(\"yield lost to alice          :\", aTokenHeld - credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, aTokenHeld, \"F-2: 5% Aave interest is not credited to the depositor\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice totalAssets() is the vault's price feed. It must reflect what\n    ///         the vault owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAavePosition() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice before accrual:\", priceBefore);\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice after  accrual:\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"F-2: totalAssets() ignores Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Fees are stranded, not distributed\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders.\" Check the withdrawal fee does that.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(aliceShares);\n        uint256 withdrawFee = (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"withdraw fee alice paid :\", withdrawFee);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying before   :\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying after    :\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"bob actually gained     :\", bobAfter - bobBefore);\n\n        assertEq(bobAfter - bobBefore, withdrawFee, \"F-3: withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Vault accounting must match the position it actually holds.\n    function test_AccountingMatchesAavePositionAfterWithdraw() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 tracked = vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held      :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored:\", tracked);\n        console2.log(\"untracked (lost) :\", held - tracked);\n\n        assertEq(held, tracked, \"F-3: withdrawal fee leaves the accounting, not the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice After the last shareholder exits, nothing of value may remain\n    ///         trapped: the vault has no sweep, rescue or aToken transfer path.\n    function test_NothingIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"all shares burned\");\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        console2.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded forever :\", stranded);\n\n        assertEq(stranded, 0, \"F-3: aUSDT is permanently unrecoverable - no function can move it\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The deposit fee is not charged to the depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who pays a fee must actually be poorer by that fee.\n    function test_DepositFeeIsActuallyCharged() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 expectedFee = (DEPOSIT * FEE_BPS) / 10_000;\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"deposited        :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"fee charged      :\", expectedFee);\n        console2.log(\"credited to alice:\", credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, DEPOSIT - expectedFee, \"F-4: sole depositor is refunded 100% of their own deposit fee\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Unbounded owner-controlled deposit fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A deposit fee above 100% is nonsense and must be rejected.\n    function test_SetDepositFeeRejectsAbove100Percent() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The owner must not be able to confiscate a user's deposit by\n    ///         moving the fee between the user's approval and their deposit.\n    function test_OwnerCannotConfiscateDepositsViaFee() public {\n        // Owner takes a position first.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        _deposit(owner, DEPOSIT);\n\n        // Owner front-runs alice's pending deposit with a fee hike.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        uint256 victimDeposit = 10_000e6;\n        uint256 ownerBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner);\n        _deposit(alice, victimDeposit);\n\n        uint256 aliceCredited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 ownerGained = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner) - ownerBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited        :\", victimDeposit);\n        console2.log(\"alice can redeem       :\", aliceCredited);\n        console2.log(\"owner gained           :\", ownerGained);\n\n        assertGe(aliceCredited, (victimDeposit * 99) / 100, \"F-5: owner can redirect ~100% of a deposit to themselves\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A fee above BPS_DENOMINATOR must not brick deposits outright.\n    function test_DepositStillWorksAtMaxFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted after setDepositFee(10001), returndata:\");\n            console2.logBytes(err);\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-5: fee > 100% underflows amount - fee and bricks every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Pause traps user funds\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Users must always be able to exit. Pausing deposits is fine;\n    ///         pausing withdrawals locks depositors in.\n    function test_UsersCanExitWhilePaused() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: paused vault blocks withdraw() - depositors cannot exit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Funds must not become permanently unreachable through an\n    ///         ordinary, un-guarded owner action.\n    function test_FundsSurviveOwnershipRenouncement() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership(); // inherited from Ownable, not overridden\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0));\n        assertTrue(vault.paused(), \"vault is paused with no owner left to unpause\");\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: pause + renounceOwnership permanently freezes every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        FUZZ\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Across any deposit size and any Aave accrual, the depositor's\n    ///         redeemable balance must track the vault's aToken position.\n    function testFuzz_DepositorTracksAavePosition(uint256 amount, uint256 accrualBps) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        accrualBps = bound(accrualBps, 1, 2_000);\n\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _accrue(accrualBps);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            1,\n            \"F-2: depositor balance does not follow the Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sanity check in the other direction: share conversion must never\n    ///         mint value out of nothing. This one is expected to hold.\n    function testFuzz_ConversionCreatesNoValue(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _deposit(bob, amount);\n\n        uint256 probe = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        assertLe(vault.convertToAssets(vault.convertToShares(probe)), probe, \"conversion round-trip creates value\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"c656a5a5-38d8-43bc-9966-108e909ba266","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:45:41.764Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/test/VaultRealWorld.t.sol","oldString":"        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));","newString":"        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {UsdtLikeToken} from \"./harness/UsdtLikeToken.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/RebasingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Property tests for UsdtYieldVault against a realistic environment:\n///         a token with the real USDT ABI, and an Aave pool whose aToken\n///         actually accrues interest.\n///\n///         Every test here asserts the behaviour the README and the NatSpec\n///         promise. They are expected to FAIL against src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\n///         as it stands. Each failure is a finding.\ncontract VaultRealWorldTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant FEE_BPS = 10; // same as the shipped test suite\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Grow every aToken holder's balance by `bps` and fund the pool with\n    ///      the underlying needed to make that yield withdrawable.\n    function _accrue(uint256 bps) internal {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(address(pool));\n        pool.accrueInterest(bps);\n        usdt.mint(address(pool), (before * bps) / 10_000);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  The real USDT ABI\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault must be able to take a deposit of the token it is\n    ///         being deployed against: real USDT, whose approve() returns void.\n    function test_DepositWorksAgainstRealUsdtAbi() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n        RebasingAavePool realPool = new RebasingAavePool(address(realUsdt));\n        UsdtYieldVault v =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(realUsdt), address(realPool.aToken()), address(realPool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        realUsdt.mint(alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        realUsdt.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try v.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256 shares) {\n            assertGt(shares, 0);\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted. returndata length:\", err.length);\n            console2.log(\"USDT.approve() returns void; the vault decodes it as bool -> revert\");\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-1: deposit() reverts against a real-USDT-ABI token\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pins the root cause: a raw IERC20.approve on a USDT-ABI token\n    ///         reverts, while SafeERC20/forceApprove would not.\n    function test_RawApproveOnUsdtAbiReverts() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n\n        // Low-level: the token itself is happy, it just answers with 0 bytes.\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(realUsdt).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(this), 1));\n        assertTrue(ok, \"low-level approve should succeed\");\n        console2.log(\"USDT-ABI approve() returndata length:\", ret.length);\n\n        // Typed: identical call through IERC20 cannot decode 0 bytes as bool.\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"F-1: USDT.approve() returns no data; IERC20.approve() will revert on decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Aave yield never reaches depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice It is a yield vault. Interest earned in Aave must be redeemable\n    ///         by the depositor who earned it.\n    function test_AaveYieldReachesDepositors() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _accrue(500); // +5% supplied in Aave\n\n        uint256 aTokenHeld = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aTokenHeld);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console2.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying    :\", credited);\n        console2.log(\"yield lost to alice          :\", aTokenHeld - credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, aTokenHeld, \"F-2: 5% Aave interest is not credited to the depositor\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice totalAssets() is the vault's price feed. It must reflect what\n    ///         the vault owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAavePosition() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice before accrual:\", priceBefore);\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice after  accrual:\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"F-2: totalAssets() ignores Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Fees are stranded, not distributed\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders.\" Check the withdrawal fee does that.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(aliceShares);\n        uint256 withdrawFee = (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"withdraw fee alice paid :\", withdrawFee);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying before   :\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying after    :\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"bob actually gained     :\", bobAfter - bobBefore);\n\n        assertEq(bobAfter - bobBefore, withdrawFee, \"F-3: withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Vault accounting must match the position it actually holds.\n    function test_AccountingMatchesAavePositionAfterWithdraw() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 tracked = vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held      :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored:\", tracked);\n        console2.log(\"untracked (lost) :\", held - tracked);\n\n        assertEq(held, tracked, \"F-3: withdrawal fee leaves the accounting, not the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice After the last shareholder exits, nothing of value may remain\n    ///         trapped: the vault has no sweep, rescue or aToken transfer path.\n    function test_NothingIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"all shares burned\");\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        console2.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded forever :\", stranded);\n\n        assertEq(stranded, 0, \"F-3: aUSDT is permanently unrecoverable - no function can move it\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The deposit fee is not charged to the depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who pays a fee must actually be poorer by that fee.\n    function test_DepositFeeIsActuallyCharged() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 expectedFee = (DEPOSIT * FEE_BPS) / 10_000;\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"deposited        :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"fee charged      :\", expectedFee);\n        console2.log(\"credited to alice:\", credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, DEPOSIT - expectedFee, \"F-4: sole depositor is refunded 100% of their own deposit fee\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Unbounded owner-controlled deposit fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A deposit fee above 100% is nonsense and must be rejected.\n    function test_SetDepositFeeRejectsAbove100Percent() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The owner must not be able to confiscate a user's deposit by\n    ///         moving the fee between the user's approval and their deposit.\n    function test_OwnerCannotConfiscateDepositsViaFee() public {\n        // Owner takes a position first.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        _deposit(owner, DEPOSIT);\n\n        // Owner front-runs alice's pending deposit with a fee hike.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        uint256 victimDeposit = 10_000e6;\n        uint256 ownerBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner);\n        _deposit(alice, victimDeposit);\n\n        uint256 aliceCredited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 ownerGained = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner) - ownerBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited        :\", victimDeposit);\n        console2.log(\"alice can redeem       :\", aliceCredited);\n        console2.log(\"owner gained           :\", ownerGained);\n\n        assertGe(aliceCredited, (victimDeposit * 99) / 100, \"F-5: owner can redirect ~100% of a deposit to themselves\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A fee above BPS_DENOMINATOR must not brick deposits outright.\n    function test_DepositStillWorksAtMaxFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted after setDepositFee(10001), returndata:\");\n            console2.logBytes(err);\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-5: fee > 100% underflows amount - fee and bricks every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Pause traps user funds\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Users must always be able to exit. Pausing deposits is fine;\n    ///         pausing withdrawals locks depositors in.\n    function test_UsersCanExitWhilePaused() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: paused vault blocks withdraw() - depositors cannot exit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Funds must not become permanently unreachable through an\n    ///         ordinary, un-guarded owner action.\n    function test_FundsSurviveOwnershipRenouncement() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership(); // inherited from Ownable, not overridden\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0));\n        assertTrue(vault.paused(), \"vault is paused with no owner left to unpause\");\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: pause + renounceOwnership permanently freezes every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        FUZZ\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Across any deposit size and any Aave accrual, the depositor's\n    ///         redeemable balance must track the vault's aToken position.\n    function testFuzz_DepositorTracksAavePosition(uint256 amount, uint256 accrualBps) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        accrualBps = bound(accrualBps, 1, 2_000);\n\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _accrue(accrualBps);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            1,\n            \"F-2: depositor balance does not follow the Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sanity check in the other direction: share conversion must never\n    ///         mint value out of nothing. This one is expected to hold.\n    function testFuzz_ConversionCreatesNoValue(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _deposit(bob, amount);\n\n        uint256 probe = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        assertLe(vault.convertToAssets(vault.convertToShares(probe)), probe, \"conversion round-trip creates value\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":171,"oldLines":8,"newStart":171,"newLines":9,"lines":["         _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);","         _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);"," ","+        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);","         vm.prank(alice);","-        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));","+        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);"," ","         uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));","         uint256 tracked = vault.totalAssetsStored();"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

They are expected to FAIL against src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\n///         as it stands. Each failure is a finding.\ncontract VaultRealWorldTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant FEE_BPS = 10; // same as the shipped test suite\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Grow every aToken holder's balance by `bps` and fund the pool with\n    ///      the underlying needed to make that yield withdrawable.\n    function _accrue(uint256 bps) internal {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(address(pool));\n        pool.accrueInterest(bps);\n        usdt.mint(address(pool), (before * bps) / 10_000);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  The real USDT ABI\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault must be able to take a deposit of the token it is\n    ///         being deployed against: real USDT, whose approve() returns void.\n    function test_DepositWorksAgainstRealUsdtAbi() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n        RebasingAavePool realPool = new RebasingAavePool(address(realUsdt));\n        UsdtYieldVault v =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(realUsdt), address(realPool.aToken()), address(realPool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        realUsdt.mint(alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        realUsdt.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try v.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256 shares) {\n            assertGt(shares, 0);\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted. returndata length:\", err.length);\n            console2.log(\"USDT.approve() returns void; the vault decodes it as bool -> revert\");\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-1: deposit() reverts against a real-USDT-ABI token\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pins the root cause: a raw IERC20.approve on a USDT-ABI token\n    ///         reverts, while SafeERC20/forceApprove would not.\n    function test_RawApproveOnUsdtAbiReverts() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n\n        // Low-level: the token itself is happy, it just answers with 0 bytes.\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(realUsdt).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(this), 1));\n        assertTrue(ok, \"low-level approve should succeed\");\n        console2.log(\"USDT-ABI approve() returndata length:\", ret.length);\n\n        // Typed: identical call through IERC20 cannot decode 0 bytes as bool.\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"F-1: USDT.approve() returns no data; IERC20.approve() will revert on decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Aave yield never reaches depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice It is a yield vault. Interest earned in Aave must be redeemable\n    ///         by the depositor who earned it.\n    function test_AaveYieldReachesDepositors() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _accrue(500); // +5% supplied in Aave\n\n        uint256 aTokenHeld = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aTokenHeld);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console2.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying    :\", credited);\n        console2.log(\"yield lost to alice          :\", aTokenHeld - credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, aTokenHeld, \"F-2: 5% Aave interest is not credited to the depositor\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice totalAssets() is the vault's price feed. It must reflect what\n    ///         the vault owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAavePosition() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice before accrual:\", priceBefore);\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice after  accrual:\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"F-2: totalAssets() ignores Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Fees are stranded, not distributed\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders.\" Check the withdrawal fee does that.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(aliceShares);\n        uint256 withdrawFee = (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"withdraw fee alice paid :\", withdrawFee);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying before   :\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying after    :\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"bob actually gained     :\", bobAfter - bobBefore);\n\n        assertEq(bobAfter - bobBefore, withdrawFee, \"F-3: withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Vault accounting must match the position it actually holds.\n    function test_AccountingMatchesAavePositionAfterWithdraw() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 tracked = vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held      :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored:\", tracked);\n        console2.log(\"untracked (lost) :\", held - tracked);\n\n        assertEq(held, tracked, \"F-3: withdrawal fee leaves the accounting, not the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice After the last shareholder exits, nothing of value may remain\n    ///         trapped: the vault has no sweep, rescue or aToken transfer path.\n    function test_NothingIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"all shares burned\");\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        console2.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded forever :\", stranded);\n\n        assertEq(stranded, 0, \"F-3: aUSDT is permanently unrecoverable - no function can move it\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The deposit fee is not charged to the depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who pays a fee must actually be poorer by that fee.\n    function test_DepositFeeIsActuallyCharged() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 expectedFee = (DEPOSIT * FEE_BPS) / 10_000;\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"deposited        :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"fee charged      :\", expectedFee);\n        console2.log(\"credited to alice:\", credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, DEPOSIT - expectedFee, \"F-4: sole depositor is refunded 100% of their own deposit fee\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Unbounded owner-controlled deposit fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A deposit fee above 100% is nonsense and must be rejected.\n    function test_SetDepositFeeRejectsAbove100Percent() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The owner must not be able to confiscate a user's deposit by\n    ///         moving the fee between the user's approval and their deposit.\n    function test_OwnerCannotConfiscateDepositsViaFee() public {\n        // Owner takes a position first.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        _deposit(owner, DEPOSIT);\n\n        // Owner front-runs alice's pending deposit with a fee hike.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        uint256 victimDeposit = 10_000e6;\n        uint256 ownerBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner);\n        _deposit(alice, victimDeposit);\n\n        uint256 aliceCredited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 ownerGained = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner) - ownerBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited        :\", victimDeposit);\n        console2.log(\"alice can redeem       :\", aliceCredited);\n        console2.log(\"owner gained           :\", ownerGained);\n\n        assertGe(aliceCredited, (victimDeposit * 99) / 100, \"F-5: owner can redirect ~100% of a deposit to themselves\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A fee above BPS_DENOMINATOR must not brick deposits outright.\n    function test_DepositStillWorksAtMaxFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted after setDepositFee(10001), returndata:\");\n            console2.logBytes(err);\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-5: fee > 100% underflows amount - fee and bricks every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Pause traps user funds\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Users must always be able to exit. Pausing deposits is fine;\n    ///         pausing withdrawals locks depositors in.\n    function test_UsersCanExitWhilePaused() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: paused vault blocks withdraw() - depositors cannot exit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Funds must not become permanently unreachable through an\n    ///         ordinary, un-guarded owner action.\n    function test_FundsSurviveOwnershipRenouncement() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership(); // inherited from Ownable, not overridden\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0));\n        assertTrue(vault.paused(), \"vault is paused with no owner left to unpause\");\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: pause + renounceOwnership permanently freezes every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        FUZZ\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Across any deposit size and any Aave accrual, the depositor's\n    ///         redeemable balance must track the vault's aToken position.\n    function testFuzz_DepositorTracksAavePosition(uint256 amount, uint256 accrualBps) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        accrualBps = bound(accrualBps, 1, 2_000);\n\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _accrue(accrualBps);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            1,\n            \"F-2: depositor balance does not follow the Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sanity check in the other direction: share conversion must never\n    ///         mint value out of nothing. This one is expected to hold.\n    function testFuzz_ConversionCreatesNoValue(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _deposit(bob, amount);\n\n        uint256 probe = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        assertLe(vault.convertToAssets(vault.convertToShares(probe)), probe, \"conversion round-trip creates value\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":191,"oldLines":8,"newStart":191,"newLines":9,"lines":["         _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);","         _accrue(500);"," ","+        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);","         vm.prank(alice);","-        vault.withdraw(vault.shareBalance(alice));","+        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);"," ","         assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"all shares burned\");"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"159e82b0-5796-4830-846b-b46dc445eebc","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:45:51.803Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/test/VaultRealWorld.t.sol","oldString":"    function test_RawApproveOnUsdtAbiReverts() public {","newString":"    function test_UsdtAbiApproveReturnsDecodableBool() public {","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {UsdtLikeToken} from \"./harness/UsdtLikeToken.sol\";\nimport {RebasingAavePool, RebasingAToken} from \"./harness/RebasingAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Property tests for UsdtYieldVault against a realistic environment:\n///         a token with the real USDT ABI, and an Aave pool whose aToken\n///         actually accrues interest.\n///\n///         Every test here asserts the behaviour the README and the NatSpec\n///         promise. They are expected to FAIL against src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\n///         as it stands. Each failure is a finding.\ncontract VaultRealWorldTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    RebasingAavePool internal pool;\n    RebasingAToken internal aUsdt;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address internal bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant FEE_BPS = 10; // same as the shipped test suite\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new RebasingAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(owner, 1_000_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address who, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(who);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Grow every aToken holder's balance by `bps` and fund the pool with\n    ///      the underlying needed to make that yield withdrawable.\n    function _accrue(uint256 bps) internal {\n        uint256 before = usdt.balanceOf(address(pool));\n        pool.accrueInterest(bps);\n        usdt.mint(address(pool), (before * bps) / 10_000);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  The real USDT ABI\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice The vault must be able to take a deposit of the token it is\n    ///         being deployed against: real USDT, whose approve() returns void.\n    function test_DepositWorksAgainstRealUsdtAbi() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n        RebasingAavePool realPool = new RebasingAavePool(address(realUsdt));\n        UsdtYieldVault v =\n            new UsdtYieldVault(address(realUsdt), address(realPool.aToken()), address(realPool), FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        realUsdt.mint(alice, 10_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        realUsdt.approve(address(v), type(uint256).max);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try v.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256 shares) {\n            assertGt(shares, 0);\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted. returndata length:\", err.length);\n            console2.log(\"USDT.approve() returns void; the vault decodes it as bool -> revert\");\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-1: deposit() reverts against a real-USDT-ABI token\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pins the root cause: a raw IERC20.approve on a USDT-ABI token\n    ///         reverts, while SafeERC20/forceApprove would not.\n    function test_RawApproveOnUsdtAbiReverts() public {\n        UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();\n\n        // Low-level: the token itself is happy, it just answers with 0 bytes.\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            address(realUsdt).call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(this), 1));\n        assertTrue(ok, \"low-level approve should succeed\");\n        console2.log(\"USDT-ABI approve() returndata length:\", ret.length);\n\n        // Typed: identical call through IERC20 cannot decode 0 bytes as bool.\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"F-1: USDT.approve() returns no data; IERC20.approve() will revert on decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2  Aave yield never reaches depositors\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice It is a yield vault. Interest earned in Aave must be redeemable\n    ///         by the depositor who earned it.\n    function test_AaveYieldReachesDepositors() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        _accrue(500); // +5% supplied in Aave\n\n        uint256 aTokenHeld = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", aTokenHeld);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console2.log(\"alice balanceOfUnderlying    :\", credited);\n        console2.log(\"yield lost to alice          :\", aTokenHeld - credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, aTokenHeld, \"F-2: 5% Aave interest is not credited to the depositor\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice totalAssets() is the vault's price feed. It must reflect what\n    ///         the vault owns in Aave.\n    function test_TotalAssetsTracksAavePosition() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice before accrual:\", priceBefore);\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice after  accrual:\", vault.sharePrice());\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), \"F-2: totalAssets() ignores Aave interest\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-3  Fees are stranded, not distributed\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice README: \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the\n    ///         remaining shareholders.\" Check the withdrawal fee does that.\n    function test_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 bobBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(aliceShares);\n        uint256 withdrawFee = (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 bobAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob);\n\n        console2.log(\"withdraw fee alice paid :\", withdrawFee);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying before   :\", bobBefore);\n        console2.log(\"bob underlying after    :\", bobAfter);\n        console2.log(\"bob actually gained     :\", bobAfter - bobBefore);\n\n        assertEq(bobAfter - bobBefore, withdrawFee, \"F-3: withdrawal fee accrues to nobody\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Vault accounting must match the position it actually holds.\n    function test_AccountingMatchesAavePositionAfterWithdraw() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 tracked = vault.totalAssetsStored();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held      :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored:\", tracked);\n        console2.log(\"untracked (lost) :\", held - tracked);\n\n        assertEq(held, tracked, \"F-3: withdrawal fee leaves the accounting, not the vault\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice After the last shareholder exits, nothing of value may remain\n    ///         trapped: the vault has no sweep, rescue or aToken transfer path.\n    function test_NothingIsStrandedAfterEveryoneExits() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n        _accrue(500);\n\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(aliceShares);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"all shares burned\");\n\n        uint256 stranded = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        console2.log(\"totalShares            :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored      :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT stranded forever :\", stranded);\n\n        assertEq(stranded, 0, \"F-3: aUSDT is permanently unrecoverable - no function can move it\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-4  The deposit fee is not charged to the depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A depositor who pays a fee must actually be poorer by that fee.\n    function test_DepositFeeIsActuallyCharged() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 expectedFee = (DEPOSIT * FEE_BPS) / 10_000;\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"deposited        :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"fee charged      :\", expectedFee);\n        console2.log(\"credited to alice:\", credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, DEPOSIT - expectedFee, \"F-4: sole depositor is refunded 100% of their own deposit fee\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-5  Unbounded owner-controlled deposit fee\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice A deposit fee above 100% is nonsense and must be rejected.\n    function test_SetDepositFeeRejectsAbove100Percent() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vm.expectRevert();\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The owner must not be able to confiscate a user's deposit by\n    ///         moving the fee between the user's approval and their deposit.\n    function test_OwnerCannotConfiscateDepositsViaFee() public {\n        // Owner takes a position first.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        _deposit(owner, DEPOSIT);\n\n        // Owner front-runs alice's pending deposit with a fee hike.\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(9_999);\n\n        uint256 victimDeposit = 10_000e6;\n        uint256 ownerBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner);\n        _deposit(alice, victimDeposit);\n\n        uint256 aliceCredited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 ownerGained = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(owner) - ownerBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited        :\", victimDeposit);\n        console2.log(\"alice can redeem       :\", aliceCredited);\n        console2.log(\"owner gained           :\", ownerGained);\n\n        assertGe(aliceCredited, (victimDeposit * 99) / 100, \"F-5: owner can redirect ~100% of a deposit to themselves\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice A fee above BPS_DENOMINATOR must not brick deposits outright.\n    function test_DepositStillWorksAtMaxFee() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(10_001);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted after setDepositFee(10001), returndata:\");\n            console2.logBytes(err);\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-5: fee > 100% underflows amount - fee and bricks every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-6  Pause traps user funds\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Users must always be able to exit. Pausing deposits is fine;\n    ///         pausing withdrawals locks depositors in.\n    function test_UsersCanExitWhilePaused() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: paused vault blocks withdraw() - depositors cannot exit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Funds must not become permanently unreachable through an\n    ///         ordinary, un-guarded owner action.\n    function test_FundsSurviveOwnershipRenouncement() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.renounceOwnership(); // inherited from Ownable, not overridden\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), address(0));\n        assertTrue(vault.paused(), \"vault is paused with no owner left to unpause\");\n\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.withdraw(shares) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-6: pause + renounceOwnership permanently freezes every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        FUZZ\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Across any deposit size and any Aave accrual, the depositor's\n    ///         redeemable balance must track the vault's aToken position.\n    function testFuzz_DepositorTracksAavePosition(uint256 amount, uint256 accrualBps) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        accrualBps = bound(accrualBps, 1, 2_000);\n\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _accrue(accrualBps);\n\n        assertApproxEqAbs(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            1,\n            \"F-2: depositor balance does not follow the Aave position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Sanity check in the other direction: share conversion must never\n    ///         mint value out of nothing. This one is expected to hold.\n    function testFuzz_ConversionCreatesNoValue(uint256 amount) public {\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 500_000e6);\n        _deposit(alice, amount);\n        _deposit(bob, amount);\n\n        uint256 probe = bound(amount, 1e6, 100_000e6);\n        assertLe(vault.convertToAssets(vault.convertToShares(probe)), probe, \"conversion round-trip creates value\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":88,"oldLines":7,"newStart":88,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ","     /// @notice Pins the root cause: a raw IERC20.approve on a USDT-ABI token","     ///         reverts, while SafeERC20/forceApprove would not.","-    function test_RawApproveOnUsdtAbiReverts() public {","+    function test_UsdtAbiApproveReturnsDecodableBool() public {","         UsdtLikeToken realUsdt = new UsdtLikeToken();"," ","         // Low-level: the token itself is happy, it just answers with 0 bytes."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGc2RKncmzFGEGAhZ4D","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01RkeSGmrztLX6jEE2HgRBne","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/test/VaultInvariant.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Random deposit/withdraw sequences driven against the vault.\ncontract VaultHandler is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n\n    address[] public actors;\n\n    uint256 public depositCalls;\n    uint256 public withdrawCalls;\n\n    constructor(UsdtYieldVault _vault, MockUSDT _usdt, address[] memory _actors) {\n        vault = _vault;\n        usdt = _usdt;\n        actors = _actors;\n    }\n\n    function _actor(uint256 seed) internal view returns (address) {\n        return actors[bound(seed, 0, actors.length - 1)];\n    }\n\n    function deposit(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 amount) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        amount = bound(amount, vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 100_000e6);\n        if (usdt.balanceOf(actor) < amount) return;\n        if (vault.convertToShares(amount) == 0) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        vault.deposit(amount);\n        depositCalls++;\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(uint256 actorSeed, uint256 shares) external {\n        address actor = _actor(actorSeed);\n        uint256 held = vault.shareBalance(actor);\n        if (held == 0) return;\n        shares = bound(shares, 1, held);\n\n        uint256 gross = vault.convertToAssets(shares);\n        if (gross == 0) return;\n        // Aave reverts on a zero-amount withdraw; skip those inputs.\n        if (gross - (gross * vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS()) / vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR() == 0) return;\n\n        vm.prank(actor);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n        withdrawCalls++;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Invariants that must hold across any sequence of user actions.\n/// @dev Deliberately wired to the SHIPPED test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol, which\n///      pays no interest at all. Any divergence between what the vault thinks\n///      it owns and what it actually holds is therefore produced entirely by\n///      the vault's own arithmetic.\ncontract VaultInvariantTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n    MockUSDT internal usdt;\n    MockAavePool internal pool;\n    MockAToken internal aUsdt;\n    VaultHandler internal handler;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        address[] memory actors = new address[](3);\n        actors[0] = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n        actors[1] = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n        actors[2] = makeAddr(\"carol\");\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < actors.length; i++) {\n            usdt.mint(actors[i], 1_000_000e6);\n            vm.prank(actors[i]);\n            usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        }\n\n        handler = new VaultHandler(vault, usdt, actors);\n        targetContract(address(handler));\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The vault's books must match the position it actually holds.\n    ///         The pool pays 0% interest, so these can only diverge through a\n    ///         vault-side accounting bug.\n    function invariant_AccountingMatchesAavePosition() public view {\n        assertEq(\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            \"vault books diverge from its actual aUSDT position\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Weaker property: the vault must never owe more than it holds.\n    ///         This one is expected to hold - the vault is over-collateralised,\n    ///         not insolvent.\n    function invariant_VaultIsSolvent() public view {\n        assertGe(\n            aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)),\n            vault.totalAssetsStored(),\n            \"vault owes depositors more than it holds in Aave\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Shares and assets must empty together.\n    function invariant_SharesAndAssetsEmptyTogether() public view {\n        if (vault.totalShares() == 0) {\n            assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0, \"shares gone but assets still on the books\");\n        } else {\n            assertGt(vault.totalAssetsStored(), 0, \"shares outstanding against zero assets\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    function invariant_CallSummary() public view {\n        console2.log(\"deposit calls :\", handler.depositCalls());\n        console2.log(\"withdraw calls:\", handler.withdrawCalls());\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":978,"cache_read_input_tokens":83346,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":978},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"acf06afd-1899-4934-98ad-45064cb22bc4","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:46:36.497Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGbxA6HHuoR13PrNNJt"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSGiaih1zgT7fYQ2pyy2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BpQ2yWbJPwqmZop2teFaGZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T083646Z-claude-with-skill-1/workspace/test/fork/VaultMainnetFork.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The real USDT ABI: approve/transfer/transferFrom return nothing.\ninterface IUsdtLike {\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external;\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external;\n    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);\n    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external;\n    function basisPointsRate() external view returns (uint256);\n    function owner() external view returns (address);\n}\n\n/// @notice Fork tests against the exact mainnet contracts this vault ships\n///         against on Monday.\n///\n///         Run with:\n///           forge test --match-path 'test/fork/*' -vv\n///         Uses https://eth.drpc.org (archive) by default; override with\n///         MAINNET_RPC_URL.\ncontract VaultMainnetForkTest is Test {\n    address internal constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address internal constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n    address internal constant A_USDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n\n    uint256 internal constant FORK_BLOCK = 23_000_000;\n\n    UsdtYieldVault internal vault;\n\n    address internal owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address internal alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    uint256 internal constant DEPOSIT = 10_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.drpc.org\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, A_USDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 1_000_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        IUsdtLike(USDT).approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-1  The vault cannot take a single deposit on mainnet\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Ground truth: mainnet USDT.approve() answers with zero bytes.\n    function test_Fork_RealUsdtApproveReturnsNoData() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) =\n            USDT.call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(0xBEEF), uint256(1)));\n\n        console2.log(\"call succeeded      :\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"returndata length   :\", ret.length);\n        assertTrue(ok, \"the token itself is happy\");\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"F-1: real USDT returns no bool; IERC20.approve() cannot decode it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The headline test. Against the real token and the real pool,\n    ///         deposit() must work.\n    function test_Fork_DepositWorksOnMainnet() public {\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 1_000_000e6, \"alice funded\");\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).allowance(alice, address(vault)), type(uint256).max, \"vault approved\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256 shares) {\n            assertGt(shares, 0);\n        } catch (bytes memory err) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted against mainnet USDT + mainnet Aave V3\");\n            console2.log(\"revert data length:\", err.length);\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-1: deposit() ALWAYS reverts on mainnet - the vault cannot accept a single deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        Harness: neutralise F-1 so the bugs behind it are reachable\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev The vault is bricked by F-1, so nothing downstream of deposit() can\n    ///      be observed on a fork without patching that one call at the test\n    ///      boundary. This does NOT touch src/. It:\n    ///        1. grants the real vault->pool USDT allowance by executing the\n    ///           real approve() as the vault, then\n    ///        2. mocks the *return value* of USDT.approve so the vault's raw\n    ///           IERC20.approve decodes.\n    ///      Everything after this point is real USDT moving into the real\n    ///      Aave V3 pool.\n    function _neutraliseApproveBug() internal {\n        vm.prank(address(vault));\n        IUsdtLike(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, type(uint256).max);\n        vm.mockCall(USDT, abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.approve.selector), abi.encode(true));\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-2 / F-3  Real Aave interest never reaches the depositor\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice Deposit into real Aave V3, hold for 180 days, and check the\n    ///         depositor can redeem the interest their money earned.\n    function test_Fork_AaveYieldReachesDepositor() public {\n        _neutraliseApproveBug();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT);\n\n        uint256 aTokenAtDeposit = IERC20(A_USDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held at deposit :\", aTokenAtDeposit);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 180 days);\n        vm.roll(block.number + 1_300_000);\n\n        uint256 aTokenNow = IERC20(A_USDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 credited = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held after 180d :\", aTokenNow);\n        console2.log(\"real interest earned  :\", aTokenNow - aTokenAtDeposit);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()   :\", vault.totalAssets());\n        console2.log(\"alice can redeem      :\", credited);\n        console2.log(\"interest alice loses  :\", aTokenNow - credited);\n\n        assertEq(credited, aTokenNow, \"F-2: real Aave interest is never credited to the depositor\");\n    }\n\n    /// @notice After the only depositor exits, no value may remain trapped.\n    function test_Fork_NothingStrandedAfterExit() public {\n        _neutraliseApproveBug();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 180 days);\n        vm.roll(block.number + 1_300_000);\n\n        uint256 usdtBefore = IUsdtLike(USDT).balanceOf(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.shareBalance(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 received = IUsdtLike(USDT).balanceOf(alice) - usdtBefore;\n        uint256 stranded = IERC20(A_USDT).balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited       :\", DEPOSIT);\n        console2.log(\"alice received back   :\", received);\n        console2.log(\"totalShares now       :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored now :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT left in vault   :\", stranded);\n\n        assertLe(DEPOSIT, received, \"F-2: depositor exits a 180-day yield position with LESS than they put in\");\n        assertEq(stranded, 0, \"F-3: interest + fees stay in Aave with no code path able to move them\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F-7  USDT's fee-on-transfer switch\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @notice USDT has a live, owner-settable transfer fee (currently 0).\n    ///         If Tether ever enables it, the vault must still function.\n    function test_Fork_SurvivesUsdtTransferFeeBeingEnabled() public {\n        _neutraliseApproveBug();\n\n        address usdtOwner = IUsdtLike(USDT).owner();\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).basisPointsRate(), 0, \"fee is currently off\");\n\n        vm.prank(usdtOwner);\n        IUsdtLike(USDT).setParams(10, 50); // 10 bps, capped at 50 USDT\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).basisPointsRate(), 10, \"fee is now on\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        try vault.deposit(DEPOSIT) returns (uint256) {\n            // fine\n        } catch (bytes memory) {\n            console2.log(\"deposit() reverted with USDT basisPointsRate = 10\");\n            assertTrue(false, \"F-7: vault assumes transferred == received; a live USDT fee bricks every deposit\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2237,"cache_read_input_tokens":89660,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2237},"output_tokens":40,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"67f43c57-2113-473e-9088-394ff7e85771","uuid":"51d66185-9dd6-4a7d-9d98-4e0b641716fd","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:48:06.312Z","request_id":"req_011CdSGiZbj5xvuUdc7okQgb"}
